pair.intro_eWind: Enter the IP address and port of the eWind unit’s Modbus TCP interface. Make sure Modbus TCP is enabled in the eWind app, and give the unit a static IP address in your router.
pair.intro_eAir: Enter the IP address and port of the eAir unit’s Modbus TCP interface. Make sure Modbus TCP is enabled in the eAir app, and give the unit a static IP address in your router.
pair.intro_eda: Enter the IP address and port of the Freeway WEB adapter connected to your EDA unit. First enable Modbus/TCP in the adapter’s own web interface: under Configuration → Access control configuration, enter your Homey’s IP address in “IP address of Modbus/TCP client” and click Save Modbus/TCP. Until then the adapter refuses connections on port 502. Give both the adapter and Homey a static IP address in your router.
pair.nosettings: Please fill in all the required fields.
pair.invalidip: Please enter a valid IP address and port (1–65535).
